title: Unsafe pointer conversion in Go (go)
description: Go code converts through unsafe.Pointer. The conversion steps outside the type system, so the collector may move or free the object while a pointer still refers to it, and a wrong cast reinterprets memory as another type.
remediation: Keep the data in a typed structure, or hold the pointer only for a bounded region with the object pinned, for example a typed slice with an explicit copy.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the conversion without checking the lifetime.
